scope: Heavy-lift agricultural multirotor UAV ESC requirements from mission definition through verification and release.
completion_definition: Structure completion means the full planned requirement-domain hierarchy, status semantics, evidence rules, gate ownership and verification linkage exist. It does NOT mean product-specific values are frozen.

definition_status.DEFINED: Requirement family/schema exists with authority, gate and verification path.
definition_status.OPEN: Requirement family or child record still needs definition.

value_status.OPEN: Product value/selection is unknown and remains null/TBD.
value_status.BOUNDED: A user-approved or evidence-backed range exists but final value/selection is not frozen.
value_status.FROZEN: Product value/selection is baseline-backed and traceable.

anti_hallucination_policy.unknowns: OPEN/null/TBD remain open until user input, primary evidence, a derived calculation from frozen parent requirements, or physical measurement exists.
anti_hallucination_policy.competitor_data: Benchmark values may inform or bound trades but shall not be copied into product requirement fields without a documented product decision.
anti_hallucination_policy.legacy: Faz2/Faz3/A2/B1 are historical evidence and candidate inputs, not automatic design authority.
anti_hallucination_policy.simulation: Screening calculations, scripts and simulations are not physical verification.
anti_hallucination_policy.release_claims: No flight-qualified or production-qualified claim before corresponding gate closure.

requirement_domains.name: Vehicle mission mass and rotor architecture
Motor propeller and propulsion operating point
Battery bus input protection precharge regenerative and auxiliary energy
Inverter semiconductor PWM gate drive DC link and thermal power stage
MCU motor control timing firmware and watchdog
Protection fault response failsafe and FMEA
Flight controller CAN arming telemetry service and power interfaces
Temperature altitude wind ingress vibration and cooling boundaries
BOM footprint derating DFM serviceability and configuration control
Bring-up switching dyno thermal fault injection and flight-readiness verification

progress.note: 100% refers to the planned requirement-domain/schema structure, not product value closure or verification completion. New derived child requirements may be added without changing this structural metric.
